content.title: Power returns to Spain and Portugal. The outage's cause remains a mystery
content.summary: The cause of Spain and Portugal's widespread blackouts remained a mystery on Tuesday, with some isolated disruption remaining after power was largely restored.  Portuguese grid operator REN said power had been restored to all 6.4 million customers.  As life began to return to normal, authorities in Spain had yet to provide further explanation for why the nation of 49 million people lost 15 gigawatts — equivalent to 60% of its national demand — in five seconds.
